skills.detail:
When you are in the area around your captured Treasure, Helmeppo will appear at close range.
Helmeppo will repeatedly deal long-range charge attacks towards enemies who are capturing Treasure, with an ATK debuff and a Knockback effect.
Helmeppo will disappear after a certain amount of time passes.

When your team's Treasure Area is being captured:
Moves to your team's furthest Treasure Area that is being captured by the enemy.
A mid-range multiple hit area attack with a Knockback effect.

When your team's Treasure Area is not being captured:
A mid-range multiple hit area attack with a Knockback effect.

Nullifies Stagger for a set period of time.
This skill cannot be used in certain areas that have obstacles overhead.
skills.name: Honesty Impact

skills.detail:
When counter succeeds:
If enemy attacks within a set period of time, deals a mid-range area attack with a Knockback effect.
Also, HP will be recovered.

When counter fails:
If the enemy does not attack within a set period of time, deals a mid-range area attack.
Also, HP will be recovered.

Become temporarily invincible after use.
